title: What happens if you swallow gum

shots.line: This is what happens when you swallow gum.
shots.prompt: bald middle-aged man in a plain grey t-shirt chewing pink bubble gum, about to swallow it, waist-up, facing camera
shots.motion: the man stops chewing and gulps, slow camera push-in

shots.line: First, it slides down your esophagus in one piece.
shots.prompt: the same bald man in side profile with transparent skin, glowing blue skeleton and throat visible, a small bright pink blob of gum inside the esophagus
shots.motion: the pink blob slides down the throat toward the stomach

shots.line: In your stomach, acid strips away the sugar and flavor.
shots.prompt: cross-section of a human stomach, glossy pink tissue, bubbling green-yellow stomach acid surrounding a bright pink blob of chewing gum, tiny sugar crystals dissolving off it

shots.line: But the gum base is made of rubbery polymers your body simply can't digest.
shots.prompt: extreme macro of a pink chewing gum blob, its surface revealing tangled rubbery polymer strands like glowing elastic threads, inside a dark stomach

shots.line: So no, it doesn't stay inside you for seven years.
shots.prompt: the same bald man wagging his finger 'no' with a smug half smile, a large wall calendar behind him with the number 7 crossed out in red

shots.line: Your intestines just squeeze it along with everything else.
shots.prompt: x-ray style view of human intestines, transparent glowing tubes, a bright pink gum blob traveling through them
shots.motion: intestines contract in waves, pushing the pink blob along, slow camera drift

shots.line: And a few days later, it leaves your body.
shots.prompt: the same bald man stepping out of a bathroom door looking relieved, giving a thumbs up

shots.line: But swallow lots of gum every day, and it can build into a solid mass that blocks your gut.
shots.prompt: the same bald man seen with transparent skin, glowing blue skeleton, stomach and intestines highlighted, a large ball of tangled pink gum lodged and blocking the intestine, red warning glow around it

shots.line: Doctors have actually had to remove these from kids.
shots.prompt: surgeon in blue scrubs and mask holding up a fist-sized ball of pink gum with forceps in a bright operating room
